title: Sleep Talking Recording Coverage Gaps
dataSources: Allergy symptoms (`allergy:entry`), migraine records (`migraine:entry`), bathroom visits (`bathroom:visit`), and sleep-talking events (`sleeptalk:event`).
app: Symptom telemetry for allergy diaries, migraine aura tracking, bathroom frequency logging, and sleep-talking review sent to Splunk HEC via apps and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=sleeptalk:event
| stats latest(_time) as last_seen count as events by device_name
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_seen)/86400,1)
| sort - days_since
description: Shows which devicess have gone quiet for sleep-talking recordings.
value: Coverage gaps matter because silence might mean a calm night or simply a dead recorder.
implementation: Send sleep-talking recordings events to `index=personal` and alert when the gap since the last event grows beyond the expected cadence.
visualization: Table of devicess with time since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It blends which devicess have gone quiet longer than they should for sleep-talking recordings.
